summary: VEON Ltd. (NASDAQ: VEON) filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, announcing that BNY Mellon will waive depositary service fees on its American Depositary Shares effective January 1, 2026, reducing cost of ownership by $0.05 per ADS per year. The company also reaffirmed a capital allocation policy targeting at least $100 million annually in share buybacks. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are provided. This is an ongoing investor-relations initiative, not a transformative special situation. Watch for any future capital return changes and shareholder feedback.
